description: Minimal implementation and rendered verification for one atomic UI owner or tightly bounded visual defect.

stages.purpose: Inspect the owning component/token and apply the smallest reversible change without widening scope.

gates.require: changed owner is explicit and preserve/forbidden constraints are respected

stages.purpose: Verify the changed owner in its representative rendered state and check nearby regression risk only.

gates.require: changed UI is visually inspected and no adjacent regression is observed
